meta.name: customize
meta.description: Add new capabilities or modify NanoClaw behavior. Use when user wants to add channels (Telegram, Slack, email input), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or make any other customizations. This is an interactive skill that asks questions to understand what the user wants.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 NanoClaw 添加新通道或修改行为
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在定制 NanoClaw 的行为或集成新通道。
copy.tagline_en: Add new channels or modify NanoClaw behavior
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are customizing NanoClaw's behavior or integrating new channels.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会通过提问了解你想对 NanoClaw 做什么改动，然后帮你添加新功能或修改行为，比如增加聊天渠道、集成外部服务或调整助手个性。
howto.when: 当你告诉 Claude 你想给 NanoClaw 添加新功能或修改现有行为时触发，例如说“加个 Telegram 渠道”或“改一下助手个性”。

say.text: 帮我给 NanoClaw 添加 Telegram 输入渠道。
say.note: Claude 会引导你完成安装和配置。

say.text: 我想改一下某个助手组的个性设定。
say.note: Claude 会询问具体要改什么，然后指导你编辑文件。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 集成 Gmail 工具。
say.note: Claude 会检查是否有现成的安装技能并执行。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will ask questions to understand what you want to change about NanoClaw, then help you add new capabilities or modify behavior, such as adding chat channels, integrating external services, or adjusting assistant personality.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you tell Claude you want to add new capabilities or modify existing behavior of NanoClaw, for example saying 'Add Telegram as an input channel' or 'Change assistant personality'.

say_en.text: Help me add Telegram as an input channel for NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through installation and configuration.

say_en.text: I want to change the personality of an agent group.
say_en.note: Claude will ask what exactly to change and guide you to edit the file.
Claude will check for an existing install skill and run it.
